summary.text: Jay Jacobs is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 36 who was first elected in 2010 and has served since 2011, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former mayor of Rock Hall who owns a kitchen and bath business, he serves on the Environment and Transportation Committee.

paragraphs.text: Jay Jacobs was born in West Palm Beach, Florida, on January 28, 1953, and attended Kent County High School, according to his General Assembly biography.
He is the owner of Jay A. Jacobs Complete Kitchens and Baths LLC and has been a firefighter and ambulance driver with the Rock Hall Volunteer Fire Company since 1996.
Jacobs served on the Rock Hall planning and zoning board from 1976 to 1980, as vice mayor from 1997 to 1999, and as mayor of Rock Hall from 1999 to 2011.
Jacobs served on the Environmental Matters Committee from 2011 to 2015 and has been a member of the Environment and Transportation Committee since 2015.
He has chaired the Kent County House Delegation since 2011.

Ballotpedia reports that he advanced from the June 23, 2026 Republican primary; the general election for District 36's three seats also includes Republicans Steve Arentz and Jeff Ghrist and Democrats Nevin Crouse, Michelle Ravert and Crystal Woodward.
